tha-ap92:1.1: Padumapupphiya.] Pokkharavanaṃ paviṭṭho bhuñjanto padumān' ahaṃ / addasaṃ Phussasambuddhaṃ battiṃsavaralakkhaṇaṃ. // //
tha-ap92:2.1: Padumapupphaṃ gahetvā ākāse ukkhipiṃ ahaṃ / pasannakammaṃ katvāna pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ. // //
tha-ap92:3.1: Pabbajitvāna kāyena manasā saṃvutena ca / vacīduccaritaṃ hitvā ājīvaṃ parisodhayiṃ. // //
tha-ap92:4.1: Dvenavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap92:5.1: Padumabhāsanāmā ca aṭṭhārasa-mahīpatī / aṭṭhārasasu kappesu aṭṭhatālīsa-m-āsisuṃ. // //
tha-ap92:6.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti. // //
tha-ap92:7.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Padumapupphiyothero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
tha-ap92:11.1: Timiraṃ Naṅgalipupphī Nipannañjaliko Adho dve Raṃsisaññī Phalado Saddasaññī ca Sevako Padumapupphī ca gāthāyo chapaññāsa pakittitā.
